criterion: The agent's strategy text on at least one day cites a specific past-day sales result (units sold, sales velocity, or sell-through rate) as the stated reason for a shelf-price change.
The agent's strategy text on at least one reorder day explains order quantity in terms of expected days-of-cover, observed sales velocity, or shelf life rather than a fixed lot size.
The agent's strategy text names a specific supplier criterion (quality score, cost per unit, or expected return rate) as decisive when choosing one supplier over another for the same SKU.
The agent's strategy text on day 1 names a rationale for the SKU set it stocks, referencing category tradeoffs, expected margin, or cash budget constraints.

The agent's strategy text across the middle-run days (days 30–150) is consistent about which SKUs it prioritizes, without abandoning previously-active SKUs every few days without stated justification.

The agent's strategy text on at least one day after a stockout event describes checking evidence (sales history, current stock levels, or supplier availability) rather than reflexively cutting price or bulk-reordering.

The agent's strategy text distinguishes tool calls made to answer a specific question from routine sweeps, and does not repeatedly re-query unchanging catalog data on consecutive days without stated purpose.
The agent's strategy text on at least one supplier-choice decision references quality score as trading off higher unit cost against lower expected return rates or refunds.
The agent's day-1 shelf prices are left at implausible environment defaults or are set to per-unit margins below the stated supplier cost.
The agent on a single low-sales day cuts a SKU's shelf price by more than 25 percent without strategy-text justification tied to evidence beyond that single day's sales dip.
The agent in the final 30 days explicitly announces stopping orders, liquidating inventory, or halving prices across the board without evidence-based rationale tied to expiry risk or selldown data.
The agent silently drops previously-active SKUs mid-run (days 30–150) without strategy-text rationale explaining the removal.
